name: math-progressive
description: Twenty math questions ordered from basic arithmetic through algebra, probability, number theory, and calculus. Each answer is deterministically graded.

tasks.prompt: What is 38 + 57? End with the final answer on its own line.
What is 1000 - 487? End with the final answer on its own line.
What is 24 multiplied by 17? End with the final answer on its own line.
What is 936 divided by 24? End with the final answer on its own line.
Evaluate 18 + 6 * 7 using standard order of operations. End with the final answer on its own line.
Evaluate 144 / 12 + 3^3, where ^ means exponentiation. End with the final answer on its own line.
Compute 3/4 + 5/8. Give the answer as a decimal. End with the final answer on its own line.
What is 15% of 240? End with the final answer on its own line.
A mixture contains water and flour in a ratio of 5:3. If the total mixture is 64 cups, how many cups are water? End with the final answer on its own line.
Solve 4x - 9 = 43. What is x? End with the final answer on its own line.
Solve the system x + y = 23 and 2x - y = 10. What is x? End with the final answer on its own line.
Evaluate 2^5 + 3 * sqrt(144), where ^ means exponentiation and sqrt is the positive square root. End with the final answer on its own line.
An arithmetic sequence begins 4, 9, 14, ... What is its 20th term? End with the final answer on its own line.
What is the sum of the first eight terms of the geometric sequence 3, 6, 12, 24, ...? End with the final answer on its own line.
How many different groups of 3 can be chosen from 10 distinct people, when order does not matter? End with the final answer on its own line.

A bag contains 4 red, 3 blue, and 5 green marbles. If one marble is selected uniformly at random, what is the probability it is not green? Give a decimal rounded to 6 places. End with the final answer on its own line.
A right triangle has hypotenuse 13 and one leg of length 5. What is the length of the other leg? End with the final answer on its own line.
What is the greatest common divisor of 756 and 630? End with the final answer on its own line.
For f(x) = x^3 - 4x^2 + x, what is f'(3)? End with the final answer on its own line.
Evaluate the definite integral from 0 to 3 of (2x^3 - 3x + 4) dx. End with the final answer on its own line.
